Package io.github.lord_of_nothing.game

Class TickHandler

java.lang.Object
io.github.lord_of_nothing.game.TickHandler
public class TickHandler extends Object
Tracks fixed-interval simulation ticks independently from render framerate.

      public int update(float delta, int currentIngameDay, ResourceStateMutator resourceState, EventLog log)
      Advances simulation time, optionally applying the daily 6am citizen arrival event.
      Parameters:
      delta - time in seconds since the last frame
      currentIngameDay - current in-game day before any newly completed days are applied
